reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The metric is no longer exposed under the name envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced and is instead exposed as envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced, so metric consumers still querying the old name no longer receive it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries that reference the old metric name to use envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_rate_limit_enforced.
